title: Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis (MSPA) for Plant Spectroscopy
abstract: arXiv:2611.24599v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Plant reflectance spectroscopy across the visible, near-infrared, and shortwave infrared domain encodes foliar biochemical and anatomical traits into contiguous spectral signatures with locally differentiable structure; however, extreme inter-band collinearity and unfavorable sample-to-feature ratios challenge predictive modeling. Conventional dimensionality reduction methods routinely adopted in spectroscopy, are column-permutation invariant: they treat adjacent wavelengths as unordered tabular columns and discard the sequential differential geometry of absorption features. translated_title: 面向植物光谱学的形态-光谱投影分析
translated_abstract: 植物反射光谱在可见光、近红外及短波红外波段范围内，将叶片的生化和解剖性状编码为具有局部可微分结构的连续光谱特征；然而，极端的波段间共线性以及不利的样本-特征比例给预测建模带来了挑战。光谱学中常规采用的降维方法具有列置换不变性：它们将相邻波长视为无序的表格列，从而丢弃了吸收特征的序列微分几何结构。为此，我们提出形态-光谱投影分析（MSPA），这是一种监督式降维算子，通过三个互补的模块将连续光谱投影到紧凑的形态-光谱子空间中：(i) 加性连续统去除后的吸收深度、吸收面积以及红边拐点运动学特征；(ii) 局部多阶奇异特征模态（0阶、1阶和2阶）……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种监督式降维方法MSPA（形态-光谱投影分析），突破了传统降维方法将相邻波长视为无序列、忽略光谱序列结构的局限，通过吸收特征运动学和局部多阶奇异模态等互补模块，将植物连续光谱投影到紧凑的形态-光谱子空间以支持性状预测建模。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes MSPA (Morpho-Spectral Projection Analysis), a supervised dimensionality reduction operator that, unlike permutation-invariant conventional methods, preserves the sequential differential geometry of plant reflectance spectra by projecting contiguous spectra into a compact morpho-spectral subspace through complementary blocks such as continuum-removed absorption kinematics and local multi-order singular eigenmodes.
